digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 36
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Emberline CI adds ARM runners
items.summary: Emberline CI now offers ARM runners in four sizes, from 2 to 16 vCPUs, and they cost less per minute than x86 runners of the same size.
items.whyItMatters: Container images need an ARM variant to run on them.

items.title: Skerry adds cron triggers
items.summary: Skerry functions can now run on a schedule with cron triggers defined in the project file. Schedules run in UTC.
items.whyItMatters: A trigger that fails is retried up to three times.

items.title: Lumenstack adds adaptive log sampling
items.summary: Lumenstack's agent can now sample logs adaptively, keeping every error and a falling share of repeated info lines. The sampling rate is set per service and can be changed without a restart.
items.whyItMatters: More than 300 companies already run it in production.
